subject: Temporary rate-band elevation and prorata surcharge negotiation
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@skyforge.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@skyforge.ai
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: launch week throughput spike and temporary uplift

Hi Jasmine,

We're wrapping up a regional launch next week and expect a short, high-volume window (about 36 hours) that will exceed our current quota. Can Redwood provide a temporary throughput uplift for Dec 20-21? We can accept a surcharge but need visibility on the rate and how it will be reconciled on our next invoice.

Estimated additional tokens: ~1.8B over two days.

Procurement is CC'd — they may ask for a short amendment or PO.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product
Skyforge AI

Attachments: launch-plan.pdf (referenced)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@skyforge.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week throughput spike and temporary uplift

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We can support a short-term uplift but want to make the path predictable for both sides. High-level option we can offer: 1) Provisional uplift for the window with a prorated surcharge of 1.4x your standard per-token rate; OR 2) A blended uplift rate with a 15% surcharge and a post-event invoice credit if usage stays below the 1.9B mark you mentioned.

I'll need a short forecast (hourly peak) and confirmation of the billing contact/PO timeline. Looping in Laura from Pricing to confirm the commercial.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks. Here are the hourly peaks for the 36-hr window — attached as CSV. Procurement would prefer a single short amendment rather than a PO mid-week. They also requested an estimate of the total uplift charge so finance can pre-approve.

I can share the traffic CSV and an internal runbook once you confirm the path.

Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@skyforge.ai>, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week throughput spike and temporary uplift

Elena — hi, Ben from Commercial. Appreciate the detail. To move quickly we can do a short-form amendment: 1) Temporary uplift for 36 hours with a blended surcharge of 1.2x your standard rate (20% discount off our standard uplift surcharge). 2) If final incremental usage is below 1.9B, Redwood will apply a one-time invoice credit equal to 50% of the difference between billed uplift and actual usage-based uplift (this is our way of offering downside protection). 3) We can include a cap: maximum uplift charge not to exceed $85,000 for the window.

I'll attach a provisional amendment and a pricing breakdown. If procurement can sign a one-page amendment and return it by EOD Dec 17 we can lock capacity and preauthorize the uplift for the window.

Ben Carter
Senior Deals — Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional-amendment-SF.pdf; pricing-breakdown-SF.xlsx
